title: Present Direction
summary: Yang's research continues to advance climate prediction and extreme weather forecasting, with his models playing a critical role in understanding and predicting climate change impacts. His work integrates cutting-edge AI/ML techniques into land surface modeling while training the next generation of climate scientists.
